_about: Reference lists for tools/catalogue_stats.py and the era targets in engine/targets.json (tools/refcurve.py). Chosen during the genre research of 2026-11-24 (albums: docs/CAROLING.md, docs/LATIN_POP.md, docs/CHAMBER_SCORE.md, 'Catalogue measurements'; targets: docs/MASTERING.md 'Era targets'). Identifiers only: MusicBrainz release MBIDs (MusicBrainz core data, CC0) and the query parameters. No audio and no per-track data. 'style' records how each doc table computed its middle half (statistics.quantiles method) and whether m:ss was truncated. Granularity research (2026-11-25, merged 2026-11-26): strand albums for caroling (albums.caroling_choir, caroling_acappella) and chamber score (albums.chamberscore_granularity), strand and era targets for the other genres; latinpop_granularity lists the non-target Latin selections.
